_comment: `m0.js` and `m2.js` import each other and share one common chunk. Entry `first` imports `m6.js` before entry `a` runs, so `m6.js` has an earlier `exec_order` than `m1.js`. `m0.js` imports `m1.js` before `m2.js` reaches `m6.js`, so the common chunk must import the `m1.js` chunk first. The chunk enters the cycle through `m0.js`, which runs last and reaches `m2.js`, so `m0.js` leads the chunk.
